openQaFindings.note: PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED Donor/Donee — untranslated, uninflectable English labels inside Ukrainian sentences (onboarding.sideDonee/sideDonor, onboardingInfo.side.*, profileUi.rateDonor 'Оціни свого Donor', reviewPlaceholder, typeYourMessageForDonee, aboutDonee, plural 'Donor можуть…').

Brand/term 'Token' used as indeclinable Latin loanword in every case ('Мішок, повний Token', 'Придбані Token', 'Твої Token додано', 'їх' as pronoun). Natural alternative: 'токен/токени' (Cyrillic, declinable). Pluralization identical for all forms, so runtime-safe; style/product decision.

Existing language names: 'he' → 'Єврейська' is ambiguous (could mean Yiddish); standard Ukrainian name for Hebrew language is 'Іврит'. 'nl' → 'Голландська' (existing); 'Нідерландська' is the standard name. Not auto-changed (style/consistency with adjective pattern).

{name} placeholders after prepositions that require case (profileUi.aboutUser 'Про {name}', notificationsPage.commentTitle/replyTitle 'від {name}', posts.replyFrom, auth.replyToUser 'Відповідь для {name}…') — fine for usernames/handles, wrong if real first names are shown (UA names inflect: 'від Олени').
